title: 2008 AMC 12A Problem 1
statement: A bakery owner turns on his doughnut machine at \(8\!:\!30\) am. At \(11\!:\!10\) am the machine has completed one third of the day’s job. At what time will the doughnut machine complete the job?

solutions.text:
From \(8\!:\!30\) am to \(11\!:\!10\) am is \(2\) hours \(40\) minutes, or \(160\) minutes, to complete one third of the job.

The whole job then takes \(3 \cdot 160 = 480\) minutes, or \(8\) hours. Adding \(8\) hours to \(8\!:\!30\) am gives \(4\!:\!30\) pm.

Thus, D is the correct answer.
hints: Find how long it took to finish the first third of the job
The whole job takes three times as long as that first third
